entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Non-contiguous collection of ruined urban zones on Ravnica claimed by the Gruul Clans.

entities.name: Skarrg
entities.description: Gutted palace; closest thing the Gruul have to a guild hall.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: Leader of the Zhur-Taa clan who declared a blood feud on the Rakdos.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Elven Selesnya druid who set up a healing outpost and was killed by the Rakdos.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: Abandoned Gruul infant adopted by Cecilee.

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: Cecilee's brother who broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Led the Cult of Rakdos attack on Cecilee's outpost.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild Cecilee and Ruzi belonged to.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Gruul shaman whose planeswalker spark ignited during the Burying.

entities.name: Sabast
entities.description: Tribe's shaman who declared Domri to have passed.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Valley abutting the Rubblebelt where the Burying is performed.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild that legally claims the Utvara Valley.

events.summary: Cecilee establishes a healing outpost in the Rubblebelt and adopts the abandoned Gruul infant Zi.
events.quote: taking in an abandoned Gruul infant, naming him Zi

events.summary: Cecilee refuses to return the child to Nikya's warriors, straining the alliance.
events.quote: Cecilee refused, straining the fragile alliance

events.summary: The Cult of Rakdos led by Massacre Girl slaughters Cecilee's followers and kills Cecilee; Zi survives and is rescued by Ruzi.
events.quote: Cecilee herself was killed, unaware that her adopted son Zi had survived

events.summary: Ruzi breaks from the Conclave, turns to the Gruul, and Nikya declares a blood feud against the Rakdos.
events.quote: Ruzi officially broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul

events.summary: During the Burying at Utvara, Domri's spark ignites and sends him to Alara; on return, Sabast declares he passed.
events.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite
